The 10 crypto events worth the trip, Nov 2026–Jul 2027

Distribution · Crypto

Who this is for: founders, BD and partnerships leads deciding which crypto events to fly to in the next nine months. Skip it if you are looking for trading or retail investor events.

In short: Most of 2026's calendar has already happened, so this list starts from today. The order reflects where deals actually get done for a company selling into crypto, not attendance numbers.

Key points

  • Ranking weights decision-maker density at 40%, fit for companies selling into crypto 25%, side events 20%, and cost 15%.
  • Devcon 8 runs 3–6 Nov 2026 in Mumbai; Solana Breakpoint holds its first UK edition 15–17 Nov 2026 in London.
  • TOKEN2049 Dubai was postponed from 2026 to 21–22 Apr 2027 over regional security.
  • Bitcoin 2027 moves from Las Vegas to Nashville, 15–17 Jul 2027.
  • Book side events before the main pass, pick three target companies, and write up meetings within 48 hours.

How we ranked

Criterion Weight
Density of decision-makers (founders, BD heads, allocators) 40%
Fit for companies selling into crypto, not just building in it 25%
Side-event ecosystem, where most meetings actually happen 20%
Cost and travel for a US-based team 15%

The list

Rank Event Dates Where Best for Watch out for
1 Consensus Miami 4–6 May 2027 Miami US institutions, exchanges, founders and investors in one place Expensive; side events book out early
2 Devcon 8 3–6 Nov 2026 Jio World Centre, Mumbai Ethereum builders, wallets, infrastructure teams Builder crowd, less buying power; long trip from the US
3 EthCC[10] 12–15 Apr 2027 Palais des Festivals, Cannes European Ethereum and DeFi teams Earlier editions ran in summer, so confirm the April dates on the official site
4 TOKEN2049 Dubai 21–22 Apr 2027 Dubai Exchanges, MENA capital, offshore venue BD teams Postponed from 2026 over regional security; check travel advice nearer the time
5 Solana Breakpoint 15–17 Nov 2026 Olympia, London Solana payments and consumer apps First UK edition; ecosystem-specific
6 Consensus Hong Kong 1–3 Feb 2027 (expo floor 2–3 Feb) Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre Asian exchanges and institutions Asia-heavy crowd; expo floor only on the last two days
7 ETHDenver 2027 Not yet announced (2026 ran 17–21 Feb) Denver Hackers, grants teams, early-stage founders Dates not yet announced; check the organiser's site.
8 Bitcoin 2027 15–17 Jul 2027 Nashville Bitcoin-native companies, miners, treasury companies Moved from Las Vegas; very Bitcoin-only
9 DeFi Security Summit 1–2 Nov 2026 IIT Bombay, Mumbai (Devcon week) Protocol risk and security teams Niche, and only days away
10 Bluechip26 10–11 Nov 2026 Vienna Stablecoin risk and ratings Niche: security, stablecoin risk and regulation

Left out, and why

  • TOKEN2049 Singapore and Permissionless. Singapore's next edition is expected after July 2027, and Permissionless had not announced 2027 dates when we checked.
  • Money20/20 USA. It ran 18–21 October 2026, just before this window opens, and it is a fintech show with a crypto track rather than a crypto event.
  • Affiliate and iGaming shows. Different audience; they belong on a separate list.

How to get value from any of them

  1. Book side events before the main pass. At most of these, the meetings happen in the evenings, not on the floor.
  2. Decide your three target companies before you go, and request meetings two weeks out.
  3. Write up who you met and what was agreed within 48 hours, in the same record you use for decisions.

Common questions

What are the best crypto conferences to attend in 2027?

The top three are Consensus Miami (4–6 May 2027), Devcon 8 (3–6 Nov 2026, Mumbai) and EthCC[10] (12–15 Apr 2027, Cannes), ranked for founders and BD leads by who attends and what gets done.

When and where is TOKEN2049 Dubai in 2027?

21–22 April 2027 in Dubai. It was postponed from 2026 over regional security, so check travel advice nearer the time.

Where is the Bitcoin 2027 conference?

Nashville, 15–17 July 2027. It moved from Las Vegas and is very Bitcoin-only.

How do I get the most out of a crypto conference?

Book side events before the main pass, decide three target companies and request meetings two weeks out, and write up who you met within 48 hours.

Disclosure: lowob has no commercial relationship with any event on this list. Dates checked 17 Oct 2026.
